newsitem.title: USA: Gray Communications offers 3.5 mln B shares.
newsitem.headline: Gray Communications offers 3.5 mln B shares.

text.p: Gray Communications Systems Inc said on Tuesday it offered 3.5 million shares of its common Class B stock at a price of $20.50 per share.
Proceeds from the sale would be used to fund the acquisition of the broadcasting assets of John H. Phipps Inc, which is pending Federal Communications Commission approval.
The Class B shares would be listed on the New York Stock Exchange and trade under the symbol, the company said in a statement.
The offering was managed by Robinson-Humphrey Co Inc, J.C. Bradford & Co, Allen & Co and J.P. Morgan Securities Inc, it said.
